sr-only: Immortal Dragons 不朽真龙
sr-only: 不朽真龙是一家投资激进延寿领域的使命驱动基金，致力于支持那些经济回报尚不明确、被主流资本忽视、但具备长期价值的突破性项目。
sr-only: 不朽真龙的主要投资方向包括器官替换策略、3D 生物打印、基因疗法、人造子宫等。
sr-only: 除投资之外，不朽真龙也翻译出版书籍、资助行业会议与学术机构、制作播客和媒体内容，从而支持抗衰科学研究，布道长寿理念与信仰。

sr-only: Immortal Dragons is a purpose-driven longevity fund headquartered in Singapore. Its investment themes include replacement strategy, 3D bioprinting, gene therapy, artificial womb, longevity special economic zones, and LP positions in other long-bio funds. Beyond conventional capital investment, Immortal Dragons also engages in book translation and publishing, delivers talks and produces podcasts, sponsors events and initiatives, and collaborates on research projects.
sr-only: 不朽真龙基金（Immortal Dragons）是一家总部位于新加坡、投资激进延寿领域、规模4000万美元的使命驱动基金，由朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）创立。基金致力于支持经济回报尚不明确，被主流资本所忽视，但具备长期价值的突破性项目，主要投资方向包括器官替换策略，3D生物打印，人造子宫等。
sr-only: 基金已完成15余项投资，投资阶段覆盖前种子轮至A轮，不限地域。投资之外，不朽真龙出版翻译书籍，资助行业会议和学术机构，制作播客和媒体内容，从而支持抗衰科学研究，布道长寿理念信仰。
sr-only: 前种子轮至A轮，不限地域
sr-only: 朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）是不朽真龙（Immortal Dragons）的创始人，一家总部位于新加坡的使命驱动长寿基金。投资主题包括替换策略、神经与脑年轻化、细胞与基因疗法、生殖技术，同时也作为有限合伙人（LP）投资其他长寿生物科技（longbio）基金。朢舶洋（Boyang Wang）曾就读于新加坡国立大学和耶鲁大学。
sr-only: 基金的四个投资主题为：
sr-only: 神经与脑年轻化（Neuro & Brain Rejuvenation）
sr-only: 细胞与基因疗法（Cells and Gene Therapy）
sr-only: 具体投资方向包括器官替换策略、3D生物打印、基因疗法、人造子宫，并作为有限合伙人投资其他长寿生物科技（longbio）基金。
sr-only: 替换策略的依据是：基金认为衰老是身体"硬件"的系统性磨损，损伤仍可逆时适合修复，不可逆时只能替换为新的组织或器官。这一方向涵盖异种移植、3D生物打印、组织工程和冷冻保存。
sr-only: 基金认为科学有效性是第一门槛，要求可重复的动物数据和设计良好的早期人体研究。基金优先选择监管路径清晰、技术验证充分、临床需求不可替代的方向，不追逐热点。由于基金把衰老视为多通路、多器官、多层级的同时失衡，倾向安全的多靶点联合干预。

sr-only: Immortal Dragons (不朽真龙) is a US$40 million purpose-driven longevity and radical life extension fund headquartered in Singapore, founded by Boyang Wang (朢舶洋). The fund backs underfunded moonshot projects: breakthroughs whose economic returns are not yet clear and that are overlooked by mainstream capital, but that hold long-term value. Its main investment themes include organ replacement strategy, 3D bioprinting and artificial womb, among others.

sr-only: The fund has made 15+ investments ranging from pre-seed to Series A, and is geographically agnostic. Beyond conventional capital investment, Immortal Dragons engages in book translation and publishing, delivers talks and produces podcasts, sponsors events and initiatives, and collaborates on research projects, in order to support anti-aging research and advocate for longevity.
sr-only: Name: Immortal Dragons (Chinese: 不朽真龙)
sr-only: Founder: Boyang Wang (朢舶洋), who received his education from the National University of Singapore and Yale University

sr-only: Fund I size: approximately US$40 million
sr-only: Investment stage: pre-seed to Series A, geographically agnostic
sr-only: Also invests as an LP in other longbio funds
sr-only: The fund's four investment themes are:
sr-only: Specific investment areas include organ replacement strategy, 3D bioprinting, gene therapy and artificial womb, and the fund also invests as an LP in other longbio funds.

sr-only: The Replacement Strategy rests on the fund's view that aging is the systemic wear of the body's "hardware": damage that is still reversible can be repaired, but irreversible damage can only be addressed by replacing tissues or organs with new ones. This area covers xenotransplantation, 3D bioprinting, tissue engineering and cryopreservation.

sr-only: The fund treats scientific validity as the first threshold, requiring reproducible animal data and well-designed early-stage human studies. It prioritizes areas with clear regulatory pathways, sufficient technical validation and irreplaceable clinical need, rather than chasing trends. Because it views aging as a simultaneous imbalance across multiple pathways, organs and levels, it favors safe, multi-target combination interventions.

sr-only: Talks and podcasts: investor fireside chat at Vitalist Bay, founder interview on Beyond Tomorrow, panel discussion at Founders Longevity Forum in Singapore, investor keynote at LW3 in Singapore, keynote at Longevity Biotech Exchange in Shenzhen, among others.

sr-only: Book translation and publishing: The Case Against Death by Swedish philosopher Ingemar Patrick Linden, Chinese edition 《死亡批判》; Better With Age, Chinese edition 《乐龄：健康老龄化的积极心理学》; The Network State by former Coinbase CTO Balaji Srinivasan, Chinese online translation 《网络国家》; the Bio/Acc Manifesto; and Chapter 14 of Frontiers of Longevity Science, Vol. 3, published by Springer Nature.

sr-only: Translation of talks by longevity leaders: e.g. Aubrey de Grey (President of the LEV Foundation) and Brian Kennedy (head of the Healthy Longevity Translational Research Programme at the National University of Singapore).
sr-only: Chinese longevity podcast: a Chinese-language longevity podcast published on Xiaoyuzhou, Bilibili, Spotify and other platforms.
